name: Lance array
description: A steady beam from a ring of coupled emitters. It holds on a target without wavering.

name: Grand lance array
description: A heavy beam turret that cuts a line across a hull. The Lattice fits it in groups and fires them in agreement.

name: Coil driver
description: A long-barrelled coil gun firing dense slugs at a very high speed.

name: Grand coil driver
description: The largest coil gun the foundries make. Its slug crosses a battle line before the target can change course.

name: Phase battery
description: Rapid pulses that shift in frequency from shot to shot, which makes shields hard to tune against.

name: Bloom flak array
description: Point defence that bursts into a bloom of fragments near fast targets. It rarely wastes a shot.

name: Thesis torpedo
description: A homing torpedo that reaches its target by a patient and efficient route. The warhead is enormous.

name: Shard missile rack
description: Small homing missiles for fighters, each one tuned to a different approach.

name: Shard missile pod
description: A pod of homing missiles that fan out and arrive from several directions.
